# The quay: the land along the back of the harbour, 10 x 1.8 m, its top 0.6 m above the water.
# Top: grass texture (8da24e with d2cb3e / 627057 patches, an e8bf92 path to the pier; 0.2 m a texel).
# Sides: stone blocks (876672 / b7a39d, 0.5 x 0.25 m), cube-projected at 2 m a tile. In place.
new
add mesh cube --name Quay --size 1 --location 0 3.1 0
scale 10 1.8 1.2
apply
material new Quay --base-color 1 1 1
material texture Quay base-color textures/quay.png
material new Grass --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Grass base-color textures/grass.png
active Quay
mode edit
select all
uv cube-project --size 2
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Grass
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
# the underside is never seen: no splats for it
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export quay.glb
